{
  "skills": [
    {
      "skill_id": "esol_size_ring_transfer",
      "rules": [
        {
          "rule_id": "short_smiles_bonus",
          "conditions": {"smiles_length_bin": "smiles_short"},
          "weight": 0.5,
          "rationale": "Explicit source value prior: smiles_short had positive solubility effect; small solutes pay a low cavity-formation cost in water."
        },
        {
          "rule_id": "long_smiles_penalty",
          "conditions": {"smiles_length_bin": "smiles_long"},
          "weight": -0.6,
          "rationale": "Largest-magnitude source prior was negative for smiles_long; bulky hydrophobic solutes desolvate poorly."
        },
        {
          "rule_id": "ring_free_bonus",
          "conditions": {"ring_token_bin": "ring_token_none"},
          "weight": 0.3,
          "rationale": "Ring role carried the highest transfer weight (0.758); rigid ring systems reduced solubility in source data."
        },
        {
          "rule_id": "low_branching_bonus",
          "conditions": {"branch_bin": "branch_low"},
          "weight": 0.2,
          "rationale": "Rotatable-bond role maps to branching with transfer weight 0.758; limited flexibility lowers entropic desolvation penalty."
        }
      ],
      "ridge": 1.0,
      "prior_scale": 0.3,
      "semantic_mass_start": 0.4,
      "semantic_mass_end": 0.12,
      "ucb_weight": 0.6,
      "gp_beta_start": 2.0,
      "gp_beta_end": 1.0,
      "gp_xi": 0.01,
      "confidence": 0.4,
      "hypothesis": "Transfers ESOL size, ring and branching effects to hydration ranking. Fails because aqueous solubility mixes crystal-lattice terms absent from pure hydration free energy, and source role confidences are only 0.16-0.41."
    },
    {
      "skill_id": "polar_hbond_hydration_prior",
      "rules": [
        {
          "rule_id": "heteroatom_rich_bonus",
          "conditions": {"hetero_atom_bin": "hetero_high"},
          "weight": 0.6,
          "rationale": "Dense N/O centers donate and accept hydrogen bonds, the dominant favorable term in hydration free energy."
        },
        {
          "rule_id": "moderate_polarity_bonus",
          "conditions": {"hetero_atom_bin": "hetero_mid"},
          "weight": 0.35,
          "rationale": "Broader-coverage polar tier; some hydrogen-bonding capacity still offsets cavity-formation cost in water."
        },
        {
          "rule_id": "apolar_hydrocarbon_penalty",
          "conditions": {"hetero_atom_bin": "hetero_none", "halogen_bin": "halogen_none"},
          "weight": -0.6,
          "rationale": "Pure hydrocarbons offer neither hydrogen bonding nor polarizable halogens, so cavity cost is uncompensated."
        },
        {
          "rule_id": "midlength_counter_prior",
          "conditions": {"smiles_length_bin": "smiles_mid"},
          "weight": 0.2,
          "rationale": "Counter-hypothesis reversing the weakly supported negative smiles_mid source prior; moderate size accommodates more polar groups."
        }
      ],
      "ridge": 0.8,
      "prior_scale": 0.5,
      "semantic_mass_start": 0.5,
      "semantic_mass_end": 0.18,
      "ucb_weight": 0.55,
      "gp_beta_start": 2.2,
      "gp_beta_end": 1.0,
      "gp_xi": 0.02,
      "confidence": 0.6,
      "hypothesis": "Hydration affinity tracks polar hydrogen-bonding capacity rather than molecular size, reversing the mid-length source penalty. Fails if the score rewards small apolar solutes or if hetero_high coverage (28 items) is unrepresentative."
    }
  ],
  "selected_skill_id": "polar_hbond_hydration_prior",
  "lesson": "Source ESOL roles are size- and ring-dominated with low confidence (0.16-0.41), while hydration free energy is mechanistically governed by polar hydrogen bonding; prefer the mechanism-first prior, broaden it beyond thin bins, and decay semantic mass so revealed target data can override it.",
  "revision_summary": "Rewrote all conditions as catalog field-to-value maps required by the schema. Trimmed the source-grounded skill to the three explicit smiles_length value priors plus the two highest-transfer-weight roles. Strengthened the mechanistic skill by adding hetero_mid coverage and converting the apolar penalty into a hetero_none plus halogen_none interaction; deployed it."
}
